CircleCare - Family Caregiver | Care Organizer & Pill Reminder

# The kindest way to care for someone you love — together.

Caring for someone shouldn't fall on one person. CircleCare brings your family together to coordinate medications, appointments, and daily updates — so no one burns out and nothing falls through the cracks.

Built for every kind of care

Aging Parents Spouse Care Child Care Post-Surgery

Done. I can see her 2pm dose already.

## One subscription. Whole family included.

Only the person who creates the circle pays. Everyone they invite — siblings, a spouse, a neighbor, a paid caregiver — joins free, from a phone or any web browser. No app store, no credit card, no subscription of their own.

- Free for them, always
- Join from a text link — no download required
- They see the same meds, calendar, and updates you do

### One private place for the whole family.

Siblings, friends, caregivers — each invited, each with their own view.

### Every appointment, every medication.

Cardiology follow-up 9:00 AM Metformin 500mg 12:00 PM Physical therapy 4:00 PM

### Small updates. Big reassurance.

Tom confirmed Metformin 31m ago Lisa added a task: Pick up prescriptions 1h ago Sarah shared a photo from dinner yesterday

### Medications

A single source of truth for doses, schedules, and adherence tracking.

### OCR Scanning

Point your camera at a prescription label. CircleCare reads it for you.

### Emergency Info

Doctor contacts, insurance cards, advance directives — always accessible.

### Tasks

Assign, track, and complete caregiving tasks with clear ownership.

### Document Storage

200 MB free, 1 GB on Premium, per circle, for insurance cards and medical records.

### AI Assistant

Answers questions about schedules, meds, and adherence — privately. Included with Premium.

## Every dose, confirmed by someone you trust.

When Tom confirms Mom's 2pm pill, Sarah and Lisa see it instantly. No group chat, no double-dosing.

## Wherever your family is.

Care doesn't wait for the right device. Every family member can join from whatever they already have — Mom on her phone, the aunt who's never downloaded an app on her laptop, you from a work desktop between meetings. Same circle, same updates, everywhere.

No app store required. Open CircleCare in any browser.

Open CircleCare on the web

## Each person sees what matters to them.

Adult child Distant sibling Caregiver

For the adult child

You're juggling work, kids, and now a parent who needs more. CircleCare brings your family in, tracks the medications, and shows you that you're not doing this alone.

— See today's medications at a glance

— Shared calendar for every appointment

— Activity feed — know what happened today

— Emergency info always accessible

### Group chat + shared calendar

- —“Did anyone give Mom her 2pm pill?”
- — Appointments in one app, meds in another
- — Insurance card photo buried 300 messages up
- — No record to show the doctor

### CircleCare

- Every dose confirmed — with who and when
- Meds, appointments, and tasks in one calendar
- Emergency info and documents one tap away
- Adherence history you can export for the doctor

Keep the group chat for the photos. Use CircleCare for everything that can’t get lost.

### Free

$0/forever

- — Unlimited medications & reminders
- — 1 care circle
- — You + 1 caregiver
- — Medications, appointments & activity feed
- — 200 MB of documents

Only the circle creator pays. Invited family members always use CircleCare free.

Encrypted in transit and at rest

No ads, no data sales

You control who's in the circle

Who can join a care circle?

Anyone you trust — siblings, partners, friends, neighbors, or professional caregivers. Invited members always use CircleCare free.

Does my parent need the app?

They can use it — but they don't have to. Many families run the circle without the care recipient logging in. If they do, they see the same calendar and medication reminders.

How much does CircleCare cost?

CircleCare is free to start — one care circle, you plus one caregiver, and medication and appointment tracking. Premium is $6.99/month or $59.99/year (the annual plan includes a 1-week free trial) and adds up to 5 circles, unlimited family members, 1 GB of documents per circle, and the AI assistant. Invited members never pay.

Is CircleCare available on Android?

Yes. CircleCare is available on both iOS and Android; download it from the App Store or Google Play. It also works in any web browser at my.circlecare.app.

Can I cancel anytime?

Any time, one tap. No contracts, no cancellation fees. Your data is yours.
